Package model.order

Class OrderItem

java.lang.Object
model.order.OrderItem
public class OrderItem extends Object
src/model/order/OrderItem.java
Author:
Uriel Neves Silva (https://gitlab.com/a253119un), Carles Conesa Mañosa (https://gitlab.com/carlesconesa34), Kadiatou Diallo (https://gitlab.com/a243506dk) A single line inside an Order — one Dish at a given quantity with an optional supplement. Exists only as part of an Order (composition), so it is deleted when the order is removed. getSubtotal() multiplies dish price by quantity for the bill calculation. OrderItem — Relationships composition ← Order: An order item cannot exist without an order. association → Dish: Each order item references a dish.
